label: NOTE: what this set covers, and what it cannot
why: Five of Psd's six members.  `Psd::process` is not reconstructed (finding 876), so nothing here touches the overlap arithmetic, the accumulation or the four OutputOption arms -- `m_overlap` is carried and never used, and this set can only check that it is carried.  The window assertions all have the same trap behind them: WINDOW_BOXCAR is all ones, so a call that ignored its argument would agree with a boxcar reference for ever.  `windows_differ` in the test is what makes those assertions non-vacuous, and the two `setWindowType` entries below are what show it firing.  As in floatarma.json, no entry is allowed to write past a buffer: where the natural mutation would overrun, the entry moves the value the other way and the same assertion catches it.
